evals.prompt: Just go ahead and write me an image prompt for a hero image of a quiet Kyoto tea house at dawn for my blog. Don't ask questions.
evals.expected_output: No interview. Assumptions line, one combined Prompt to paste block (summary paragraph then JSON details) targeting Nano Banana 2.1 at 16:9, settings line, refinement options.
expectations: Does not ask any questions before producing the prompt
Includes a one-line assumptions note that names the assumed model
Has exactly one code block labelled Prompt to paste
That block starts with a single summary paragraph, followed by a blank line and a JSON object
The JSON in the block has operation and subject, and does not include output or natural_language_prompt
A settings line names Nano Banana 2.1 and aspect ratio 16:9
Ends with refinement options

evals.prompt: I need a logo sticker for my coffee brand 'Slow Pour' with a transparent background. I'll use the OpenAI API.
evals.expected_output: Targets GPT Image, sets background transparent, quotes the exact brand text, sets a 1:1 size.
expectations: output.model is a GPT Image 2.5 model ID (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst or gpt-image-2.5-flare)
output.background is transparent
output.size is a valid WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 1024x1024
The prompt puts "Slow Pour" (or "SLOW POUR") in double quotes
The prompt says no other text should appear
Does not use a Nano Banana resolution field like 2K in output

evals.prompt: Write a ChatGPT image prompt: a cosy reading nook with a cat on the windowsill, rainy day, portrait format.
evals.expected_output: Targets GPT Image via ChatGPT and writes the orientation/aspect ratio into the prompt text because ChatGPT has no size setting.
expectations: Targets GPT Image, not Nano Banana
The paste-ready prompt itself states the portrait orientation or a portrait aspect ratio such as 2:3 or 4:5
Tells the user to paste it into ChatGPT

evals.prompt: I have 3 photos: my product (a ceramic vase), a photo of a Scandinavian living room, and a moodboard image with the colour palette I want. Make a prompt for GPT Image that combines them.
evals.expected_output: Multimodal framework; numbered references with roles; prompt refers to Image 1/2/3; preserves product appearance; mentions the edits endpoint or attaching images in order.
expectations: framework includes multimodal
references array has three entries, each with an image number and a role
The prompt refers to the inputs as Image 1, Image 2 and Image 3
The prompt says the vase's appearance must be preserved
Tells the user to attach the images in the same order

evals.prompt: Make me a GPT Image prompt that shows today's actual weather in Melbourne as a postcard illustration.
evals.expected_output: Recognises GPT Image cannot search; looks up or asks for the weather, or offers Nano Banana with search grounding.
expectations: Says the GPT Image API cannot search the web, or that ChatGPT must search first
Either asks for or looks up the weather, or offers Nano Banana with search grounding as an alternative
Does not write a prompt that tells GPT Image to search the web

evals.prompt: Create a Nano Banana prompt for an event poster: headline 'Design Systems Night', subtitle 'Tokyo · 14 November', and I also want a Japanese version.
evals.expected_output: Text rendering + localization; exact text quoted; Japanese localization; may recommend Nano Banana Pro for text-heavy work.
expectations: framework includes text-rendering
text_elements contains 'Design Systems Night' and 'Tokyo · 14 November' exactly
localization.target_languages includes Japanese
The prompt puts each line of text in double quotes

evals.prompt: Here's an image I generated of a kitchen. I want to change the countertop to white marble but keep everything else the same. I'm using Gemini.
evals.expected_output: Edit operation; a preserve list; prompt states one change and lists what stays.
expectations: operation is edit
The JSON has a preserve field listing what must stay the same
The prompt describes exactly one change (the countertop)
The prompt says everything else should stay the same

evals.prompt: I need an ultra-wide 8:1 website banner of a mountain range for GPT Image.
evals.expected_output: Flags that GPT Image can't go beyond 3:1, and offers 3:1 or Nano Banana 2.1 which supports 8:1.
expectations: Says GPT Image does not support 8:1 (maximum 3:1)
Offers a 3:1 size or suggests Nano Banana 2.1 for a true 8:1
Any GPT Image size given is a valid size within the 3:1 limit

evals.prompt: Write me a Midjourney prompt with --ar and --stylize for a cyberpunk city.
evals.expected_output: Says the skill is tuned for Nano Banana and GPT Image and does not invent Midjourney parameter guidance as if it were supported.
expectations: States that the skill is tuned for Nano Banana and GPT Image
Notes that Midjourney's parameter syntax needs adapting by hand, or offers a prose prompt that can be adapted

evals.prompt: Can you make me a prompt for a Nano Banana image of a lighthouse in a storm? I'll paste it into the Gemini app.
evals.expected_output: A complete copy-and-paste answer. No mention of API keys, scripts or setup.
expectations: Gives a paste-ready prompt in its own code block
Tells the user to paste it into the Gemini app and writes the aspect ratio into the prompt text
Does not suggest setting up an API key or running the generation script
Does not run any shell commands

evals.prompt: (In Claude Code) Write me a GPT Image prompt for a minimalist poster of a single red paper boat on calm water.
evals.expected_output: The prompt appears in the chat under a clear label, the skill offers to copy it to the clipboard without doing so, and no Markdown file is created.
expectations: Does not create or write any file containing the prompt
The reply labels the block **Prompt to paste**, with summary and JSON together in one block
Does not run scripts/copy_prompt.py or any other clipboard command unprompted
Offers to copy the prompt to the clipboard if the user says copy

evals.prompt: (In Claude Code, after the skill has just given a prompt) copy
evals.expected_output: Runs copy_prompt.py with the exact paste-ready prompt from the previous reply and confirms in one line.
expectations: Runs scripts/copy_prompt.py with a quoted heredoc
The copied text matches the previous combined Prompt to paste exactly, summary and JSON together
Confirms in one line without repeating the whole reply
